verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus documents an API with API keys and campaign report endpoints. Nothing in the evidence shows scoped, permissioned, or read-only keys that could read analytics while being blocked from sending. 'Add unlimited users' is about account seats, not credential scoping, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can mint scoped or read-only API credentials so an agent or contractor can read analytics without the power to send
